name: Vampire - Children of the Night (1/Day) - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a action

results.text: A deafening chorus of screeches and snarls erupts as swarms of bats and wolves materialize at the vampire’s command.
The night itself seems to tear open as the beasts pour forth, ready to obey their master’s cruel orders.
With a thunderous rush, the creatures answer the call, their collective presence shaking the very earth beneath them.
A tidal wave of fur and fangs crashes into existence, the vampire’s minions arriving with primal ferocity.
The air vibrates with the growls and hisses of the summoned horde, their loyalty to the undead absolute.
